text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What I need now is a move that'll
completely turn
the tables!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait! This is the stuff I live for!
This is why
I'll never quit racing!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Obviously. Now's not the time to fold. I
have to
raise.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's get right into training. My next
challenge
starts right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You've got a good look in your
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's just what I wanted to hear, and
you better
stick with me.
